areas.ai/agent/src/aegisbank_agent/tools: Registry and execution of banking and knowledge tools
areas.ai/agent/src/aegisbank_agent/prompts: Versioned product prompts; not developer instructions
areas.ai/agent/tests: Agent tests with synthetic fixtures and separate layers
areas.ai/agent/tests/unit: Isolated tests of individual component behavior
areas.ai/agent/tests/integration: Tests of components connected in process
areas.ai/agent/tests/infra: Opt-in tests requiring specific services or emulators
areas.ai/rag: Evidence retrieval and generation with validated citations
areas.ai/rag/data: Versioned synthetic corpora and datasets; do not ingest automatically

areas.deploy: Infrastructure configuration; execution requires explicit scope
areas.deploy/local: Local Docker Compose and emulator configuration
areas.deploy/kubernetes: Laboratory manifests; not authorization to use AKS
areas.docs: Guides, references, and evidence with distinct validity dates
areas.functions: Event processing outside the agent's interactive request cycle
areas.ml: Classical machine-learning experiments, separate from the LLM
areas.scripts: Quality, acceptance, evaluation, and maintenance commands
areas.services: Services in the laboratory modular monolith

Request/response models separate from the ORM
areas.docs/architecture: Understand components, flow, and trust boundaries. Read CANONICAL-COMPONENTS before creating a parallel implementation.
areas.docs/architecture/adr: ADRs record decisions and historical context. Accepted ADRs are append-only; supersede a decision explicitly instead of rewriting it.
areas.docs/engineering: Code ownership, repository boundaries, and documentation/index maintenance rules
areas.docs/learning: Concept explanations and glossary. Verify implementation details against current code and tests.
areas.docs/operations: Troubleshooting procedures. Verify environment and authorization before commands that change services or data.
areas.docs/operations/runbooks: Incident, queue, dependency, and rollback procedures. Identify owned resources before destructive actions.
areas.docs/quality: Test strategy and dated reports. PASS, SKIP, BLOCKED, and historical evidence differ; check the date and command.
areas.docs/releases: Delivery evidence and portfolio material. Confirm releases with Git and tags; a document title does not prove publication.
areas.docs/requirements: Scope, coverage, and declared capability status. Planned or configured does not prove execution.
areas.history: Preserved historical material; not operational guidance or default LLM context.
areas.docs/security: Threats, controls, limits, and evaluations. Synthetic laboratory evidence does not prove universal security or compliance.
